verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Mailchimp tracks per-recipient engagement: email reports show which recipients clicked and how often (mailchimp-docs-21, mailchimp-docs-33). Transactional webhooks push per-message send, open and click events (mailchimp-docs-18, mailchimp-docs-28), and the Marketing API exists (mailchimp-docs-1, mailchimp-docs-15). However, no cited endpoint lets a developer pull a contact's sent/opened/clicked history on demand; the per-recipient data is shown only in UI reports or delivered as push-only transactional webhooks. Missing for 10: a documented Marketing API endpoint for per-member activity or engagement history, evidence of retrieving sent/open/click records for any arbitrary contact, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
